reason: The report relies on an unadjusted regression, and its positive effect (1.54) comes from confounding. When I add the pre-period controls (firm size, export history, prior export growth and others), the supplier_diversity coefficient drops to 0.05 (SE 0.25), which is indistinguishable from zero. Supplier diversity correlates with log sales (0.30), years exporting (0.18) and prior export growth (0.15), so the 'positive effect' conclusion is not supported.
